content: Bullet time effect. A young Japanese woman in a white dress tosses a bridal bouquet high into the air at an outdoor garden party. The moment the bouquet reaches its peak — time freezes. Individual flower petals detach from the bouquet and hover suspended in mid-air. Water droplets from a nearby fountain freeze into a curtain of tiny crystals catching the sunlight. Champagne bubbles from a nearby glass float motionless. Guests behind her are frozen mid-reach, fingers stretched toward the bouquet, hair and dresses caught mid-swing by the wind. Camera smoothly orbits 360 degrees around the frozen bouquet at eye level, weaving between the suspended petals and water droplets, only the camera moves while everything else remains perfectly still. Ultra-realistic, 4K HD, bright afternoon golden hour lighting, wide angle lens.

Bullet time effect. A young Japanese woman in a white dress tosses a bridal bouquet high into the air at an outdoor garden party. The moment the bouquet reaches its peak — time freezes. --- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Rules for time-stop videos
You only need to remember three things

① Declare from the very first line: “This is a time-stopping video”
→ Put “Bullet time effect.” at the start of the prompt

② List the things that stop in concrete detail
→ Petals, water droplets, champagne bubbles...
→ At least three. The more you include, the denser the image becomes

③ Reinforce at the end that “only the camera moves”
→ Without this, the AI will make everything move

In other words,
if these three aren’t all there,
it just becomes slow motion

[Thread 2] Here’s the actual prompt I used

It looks long,
but it’s just the three rules above fleshed out

I’ve included the Japanese version too, so
read that first to understand the structure,
then copy and paste the English version to use it

▼ English version

Bullet time effect. A young Japanese woman in a white dress tosses a bridal bouquet high into the air at an outdoor garden party. The moment the bouquet reaches its peak — time freezes. Individual flower petals detach from the bouquet and hover suspended in mid-air. Water droplets from a nearby fountain freeze into a curtain of tiny crystals catching the sunlight. Champagne bubbles from a nearby glass float motionless. Guests behind her are frozen mid-reach, fingers stretched toward the bouquet, hair and dresses caught mid-swing by the wind. Camera smoothly orbits 360 degrees around the frozen bouquet at eye level, weaving between the suspended petals and water droplets, only the camera moves while everything else remains perfectly still. Ultra-realistic, 4K HD, bright afternoon golden hour lighting, wide angle lens.

▼ Japanese version

バレットタイムエフェクト。白いドレスを着た若い日本人女性が、屋外のガーデンパーティーでブライダルブーケを高く空中に投げ上げる。ブーケが頂点に達した瞬間——時間が止まる。花びらが一枚一枚ブーケから離れ、空中に浮いたまま静止する。近くの噴水の水しぶきが太陽の光を受けた小さな結晶のカーテンとなって止まる。近くのグラスのシャンパンの泡が動かずに浮かぶ。後ろのゲストたちはブーケに手を伸ばした姿勢のまま止まっている。指はブーケに向かって伸び、髪とドレスは風に揺れた途中で止まっている。カメラはブーケの目線の高さでスムーズに360度回り、浮いた花びらと水滴の間を縫うように動く。カメラだけが動き、それ以外はすべて完全に静止したまま。超リアル、4K HD、午後のゴールデンアワーの明るい照明、広角レンズ。

[Thread 3] I’m compiling prompt structure patterns like this
These are ones I personally liked

https://t.co/EwJr0SSwwp

[Thread 4] This wedding example is just one case
The real core of this prompt is the structure

❶ State the format at the very beginning
❷ Character + action + location
❸ Specify the exact moment everything stops
❹ List at least three things that freeze ★ this is the core
❺ Reinforce that “only the camera moves”
❻ Style + quality

You can use it for anything by swapping out the scene

▷ Sports
　→ The moment of a shot
　→ Sweat, the ball, and sand freeze in mid-air

▷ Cooking
　→ The moment food is tossed in a pan
　→ Oil, ingredients, and steam freeze

▷ Everyday life
　→ The moment of a sneeze
　→ Droplets, hair, and paper freeze

Just replace ❹
The structure stays exactly the same

버렛 타임 효과. 흰 드레스를 입은 젊은 일본인 여성이 야외 가든 파티에서 브라이덜 부케를 높이 공중으로 던진다. 부케가 정점에 도달하는 순간 — 시간이 멈춘다. 부케에서 꽃잎 하나하나가 떨어져 나와 공중에 떠 있는 채 정지한다. 근처 분수의 물방울은 햇빛을 머금은 작은 결정의 커튼처럼 얼어붙는다. 근처 잔의 샴페인 거품은 움직임 없이 떠 있다. 그녀 뒤의 손님들은 부케를 향해 손을 뻗은 채 멈춰 있고, 손가락은 뻗은 상태이며, 바람에 흔들리던 머리카락과 드레스도 그 순간에 멈춰 있다. 카메라는 눈높이에서 멈춘 부케 주위를 부드럽게 360도 회전하며, 떠 있는 꽃잎과 물방울 사이를 누비듯 움직인다. 카메라만 움직이고 나머지는 모두 완벽하게 정지해 있다. 초현실적, 4K HD, 밝은 오후의 골든아워 조명, 광각 렌즈.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 시간 정지 영상의 규칙
딱 3가지만 기억하면 된다

① 첫 한마디로 “시간이 멈추는 영상입니다”라고 선언하기
→ Bullet time effect.를 프롬프트 맨 앞에 두기

② 멈출 대상을 구체적으로 나열하기
→ 꽃잎, 물방울, 샴페인 거품…
→ 최소 3개. 많을수록 화면 밀도가 올라간다

③ 마지막에 “카메라만 움직인다”를 다시 못 박기
→ 이게 없으면 AI가 전부 움직여 버린다

반대로 말하면
이 3가지가 갖춰져 있지 않으면

pt.content:
Efeito bullet time. Uma jovem japonesa de vestido branco lança um buquê de noiva bem alto no ar em uma festa de jardim ao ar livre. No momento em que o buquê atinge o ponto mais alto — o tempo congela. Pétalas individuais se soltam do buquê e ficam suspensas no ar. Gotículas de água de uma fonte próxima congelam em uma cortina de pequenos cristais que captam a luz do sol. Bolhas de champanhe de uma taça próxima flutuam imóveis. Os convidados atrás dela ficam congelados no meio do movimento, com os dedos estendidos em direção ao buquê, enquanto cabelo e vestidos são capturados pelo vento no meio do balanço. A câmera orbita suavemente 360 graus ao redor do buquê congelado na altura dos olhos, passando entre as pétalas suspensas e as gotículas de água; apenas a câmera se move, enquanto todo o resto permanece perfeitamente parado. Ultra-realista, 4K HD, iluminação clara de golden hour da tarde, lente grande-angular.

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DO THREAD ---
[Thread 1] Regras para vídeos de tempo parado
Só precisa lembrar de 3 coisas

① Na primeira frase, declare “é um vídeo em que o tempo para”
→ Coloque “Bullet time effect.” no início do prompt

② Liste de forma específica o que vai parar
→ Pétalas, gotas d’água, bolhas de champanhe...
→ No mínimo 3. Quanto mais, maior a densidade visual da cena

③ No final, reforce que “só a câmera se move”
→ Sem isso, a IA faz tudo se mover

Em outras palavras
se esses 3 elementos não estiverem presentes
vira apenas um slow motion comum

子弹时间效果。一位身穿白色连衣裙的年轻日本女性在户外花园派对上将新娘捧花高高抛向空中。就在捧花达到最高点的瞬间——时间静止。捧花上的每一片花瓣都脱离下来，悬浮在半空中。附近喷泉溅起的水滴凝固成一帘捕捉阳光的微小晶体。旁边酒杯里的香槟气泡静止漂浮。她身后的宾客们都停在伸手去接的瞬间，手指朝着捧花伸出，头发和裙摆也被风吹到一半。镜头以与捧花同高的视角，平滑地绕着静止的捧花 360 度环绕移动，穿梭于悬浮的花瓣和水滴之间，只有镜头在动，其他一切都保持完全静止。超写实，4K HD，明亮的午后黄金时段光线，广角镜头。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 时间停止视频的规则
只要记住 3 点就够了

① 在第一句话就宣告“这是时间停止视频”
→ 把 Bullet time effect. 放在 prompt 开头

② 具体列出哪些东西会静止
→ 花瓣、水滴、香槟气泡……
→ 至少 3 个。越多，画面密度越高

③ 最后强调“只有镜头在动”
→ 没有这句，AI 就会把所有东西都动起来

反过来说
如果这 3 点不齐
就只会变成普通慢动作
